# Real-Time Avatars

*Live, expressive talking-head generation — driving a single portrait to speak and emote in real time — as a front-end for conversational AI products.*

Created from [[wiki/sources/2026-05-24-personalive-portrait-animation|PersonaLive (Li et al., 2025)]], which achieves real-time streaming portrait animation (7–22× faster than prior [[wiki/concepts/diffusion-models|diffusion]] methods) from one photo. The product angle for Tali: pair a real-time avatar with an LLM + TTS (ElevenLabs) stack to give the AI-receptionist / voice-agent products an actual face — a concrete, lower-research-risk entry in the [[wiki/areas/entrepreneurship/_overview|agentic-SaaS lane]] and the [[wiki/self/goals|app/SaaS path]].

**Guardrail:** photo-driven face puppeteering is deepfake-adjacent. Any product use needs consent/disclosure — connects to the [[wiki/self/values|anti-commodification stance]].

See also: [[wiki/concepts/diffusion-models]], [[wiki/areas/entrepreneurship/_overview]].
